route_membership_diagnostic.interpretation: The one-replica replay interleaves both replica inputs: route call ordinals 0/2 map to original rid0 microbatches 0/1; 1/3 map to rid1. Valid only if all 368 ordered hashes and 16 sample plans reproduce. Then sorted top-k differences indicate membership changes; ordered-only differences indicate selection order changes. This is a diagnostic replay, not a trajectory or performance substitute.

configuration.strict: TF32 disabled; float32 matmul precision highest

strict_fp32.interpretation: The FP32/TF32-high run diverges in routing; the strict run has identical 736 ordered and sorted role/layer/microbatch signatures yet still fails on its second update. TF32 amplifies the earlier divergence but is not the sole explanation.

trajectory.interpretation: These observations compare the captured trajectories; they do not prove a root cause. FP32 reduction and accumulation order may differ even when sample plans and routing agree.
